extraction: Capital model and screen extracted from existing source; formula parity checked across 144 input combinations.
default: Balanced: 625 starting dues, 105 paying households, 20 percent paving gifts, 3 percent annual escalation, Worrall overlay with drainage.
removed: Budget conversation transcript, planning brief, superseded street-savings screens, sample payment roster.
dues: Shared Supabase board-only manual registry; residents cannot read household payment statuses. The mapped property roster is not a verified HBA membership list.
one_time_contribution: Optional proposed payment, default off; preset or custom amount, collection year and participating households. Added once, without escalation, separately from dues and paving gifts. Does not bill or alter household statuses.
beach_cleaning: No contract price is embedded in this public model. Cleaning is excluded from public scenarios. Authenticated board accounts can load a private unsigned-sample allowance from the protected backend; exports from those scenarios are confidential. No automatic renewal; check operating-budget overlap.
scenario_files: Version 3 saves both new allowances. Older v1/v2 files without cleaning fields load with cleaning off to preserve their saved assumptions.
